pd1-series.def: A 1-D pandas array of values with a label (index) for each position; one dtype.

pd1-dataframe.def: A pandas table: columns are Series of equal length sharing one index; each column has its own dtype.

pd1-index.def: The row labels of a Series or DataFrame. Used by .loc; need not be unique.

pd1-category.def: A column whose values come from a small fixed set of labels (dtype category), treated as groups rather than quantities.

pd1-scattermatrix.def: A grid of scatter plots of every pair of columns, with histograms on the diagonal (pd.plotting.scatter_matrix).

pd1-loc.def: .loc[rows, cols] selects by labels (slices include the end); .iloc[rows, cols] by integer positions (slices exclude the end).

pd1-groupby.def: Split rows into groups by a column's values, apply a summary to each group, combine the results: df.groupby('g')['y'].mean().

pd1-nan.def: “Not a number”: pandas' marker for a missing entry. Find with isna(); remove with dropna(); replace with fillna().
